suites.note: Includes the rewritten BC-01 workspace data-isolation suite (6 tests). These did NOT go red first -- the boundary already held -- so they were instead PROVEN capable of failing: removing the clientId scope from the outbound query in src/server/activity/client-activity.ts turned R-5 red (Client B's activity picked up Client A's prospect address). _commit_note: Deliberately records the commit whose TREE was measured, not a self-referential HEAD: stamping a hash into a tracked file changes that hash. Commits after 8b32585 touch only .bidlow records (evidence + state), never source, so this run remains valid for them. .bidlow/CHAIN.json is gitignored and therefore carries the exact HEAD the gate compares against.
